achievements.name: All Clear: Axel
achievements.description: Clear all stages in single-player mode as Axel.

achievements.name: All Clear: Blaze
achievements.description: Clear all stages in single-player mode as Blaze.

achievements.name: All Clear: Cherry
achievements.description: Clear all stages in single-player mode as Cherry.

achievements.name: All Clear: Floyd
achievements.description: Clear all stages in single-player mode as Floyd.

achievements.name: All Clear: Adam
achievements.description: Clear all stages in single-player mode as Adam.

achievements.name: All Clear: SOR1
achievements.description: Clear all stages in single-player mode with a "SOR1" character.

achievements.name: All Clear: SOR2
achievements.description: Clear all stages in single-player mode with a "SOR2" character.

achievements.name: All Clear: SOR3
achievements.description: Clear all stages in single-player mode with a "SOR3" character.

achievements.name: Throwback
achievements.description: Find one of the game's 4 hidden Retro Levels by locating a hidden Arcade Machine on a stage and attacking it. Simply entering the retro level pops the achievement - you do not need to clear it.

achievements.name: Miss Me?
achievements.description: Meet Adam during the campaign - a story-reveal moment that happens naturally as you progress.

achievements.name: Dojo Master
achievements.description: Defeat Shiva in his boss encounter during the campaign.

achievements.name: Snap Out of It
achievements.description: Defeat the possessed version of Max during the campaign.

achievements.name: Old-Schooled
achievements.description: Defeat Mr. and Ms. Y, the game's final campaign bosses.

achievements.name: Stage Mastery
achievements.description: Get an S-Rank on any stage.

achievements.name: Perfect
achievements.description: Complete a stage without taking damage.

achievements.name: Maniac
achievements.description: Get an S-Rank on all stages on Hard difficulty or higher.

achievements.name: All Too Easy
achievements.description: Complete a stage on Mania difficulty.

achievements.name: Combo Pro
achievements.description: Achieve a "Super!" combo.

achievements.name: Combo Expert
achievements.description: Achieve an "Amazing!!" combo.

achievements.name: Combo Master
achievements.description: Achieve an "Out of this world!!!" combo.

achievements.name: 100 Yen
achievements.description: Clear the Arcade mode on Hard difficulty or higher.

achievements.name: Bleeding Knuckles
achievements.description: Reach a lifetime score of 5,000,000.

achievements.name: Oops
achievements.description: Hit an ally.

achievements.name: Birth of the Cool
achievements.description: Catch a weapon in the air.

achievements.name: Eating off the Ground
achievements.description: Consume a healing item.

achievements.name: THIS IS WOOD OAK CITY!!!
achievements.description: Kill an enemy by tossing them in a hole.

achievements.name: Life's a Struggle
achievements.description: Free yourself from a grab.

achievements.name: It's Chilly in Here
achievements.description: Break both elevator window panes.

achievements.name: Family Reunion
achievements.description: In Stage 8's art gallery room, clear out the enemies, then attack the pedestal holding the Golden Chicken to knock it loose. Carry the chicken (do not attack with it, or it breaks) all the way to the end of the level - easiest in co-op with one player escorting the chicken while the other clears enemies.

achievements.name: Somebody Call the Cops!
achievements.description: Play as an SOR1-style character (Axel/Blaze/Adam's original-game moveset, which has no specials or Star moves). Collect a Star power-up, then use the special-move button anyway - instead of the usual Star attack, an SOR1 character calls in a police car that fires a rocket launcher at the surrounding area.

achievements.name: Dude, My Car!
achievements.description: Break the car in The Streets.

achievements.name: Wasted Wine
achievements.description: Break a wine bottle.

achievements.name: Walk on Foot
achievements.description: Destroy all motorcycles.

achievements.name: Demolition Man
achievements.description: Use a wrecking ball to kill an enemy.

achievements.name: Collateral Damage
achievements.description: Use a barrel or a grenade explosion to kill 3 enemies at the same time.

achievements.name: An Elegant Death
achievements.description: Use a chandelier to kill an enemy.

achievements.name: Broke My Toy
achievements.description: Break a spear.

achievements.name: All Clear: Estel
achievements.description: Clear all stages in single-player mode as Estel.

achievements.name: All Clear: Shiva
achievements.description: Clear all stages in single-player mode as Shiva.

achievements.name: All Clear: Max
achievements.description: Clear all stages in single-player mode as Max.

achievements.name: Clown Wars
achievements.description: Unlock the hidden character Roo (hold Up and the special-attack button together at the main menu). Playing as Roo, collect 3 Star power-ups and use his Star special move 3 times in quick succession to have 3 clown allies fighting alongside you at once.

achievements.name: Ultimate Warrior
achievements.description: Unlock all alternate moves for one character.

achievements.name: The Possibilities Are Endless
achievements.description: Unlock all alternate moves.

achievements.name: Phantom in the Hull
achievements.description: Reach level 18 in survival mode.

achievements.name: I Am the One
achievements.description: Reach level 30 in survival mode.
